Meghalaya to enhance border security against cattle smuggling

Meghalaya is planning to implement stricter measures to control cattle smuggling across its border with Bangladesh. This includes efforts to expedite the fencing of the India-Bangladesh border in the region. The move aims to address ongoing issues related to illegal cross-border trade.
